if (!steam_api_is_initialized()) show_debug_message("gametest: Steam not initialised: " + steam_api_last_error());
return steam_api_is_initialized() ? 1 : 0;

// Extension enums aren't available in a chunk: 8 = SteamNetworkingSendFlags.Reliable
steam_networking_sockets_send_message_to_connection(global.hb_a, global.hb_send, 8, 0, 500); return 1;

var r = steam_networking_sockets_receive_messages_on_connection(global.hb_b, global.hb_small, 10);
return (array_length(r) == 0 && string_pos("500 bytes", steam_api_last_error()) > 0) ? 1 : 0;

var r = steam_networking_sockets_receive_messages_on_poll_group(global.hb_group, global.hb_small, 10);
return (array_length(r) == 2 && buffer_peek(global.hb_small, r[1].offset, buffer_u8) == 2) ? 1 : 0;

var r = steam_networking_sockets_receive_messages_on_connection(global.hb_b, global.hb_small, 10);
return (array_length(r) == 1 && buffer_peek(global.hb_small, r[0].offset, buffer_u8) == 3) ? 1 : 0;

assert.name: Steam is initialised (tier 3: needs a signed-in Steam client)
a loopback socket pair is created and three 40-byte messages sent
a 100-byte buffer takes the first two messages
the third isn't lost: the next receive returns it
a buffer too small for it returns nothing and says it needs 500 bytes
with a big enough buffer the 500-byte message is returned
the receiving connection joins a poll group and three numbered messages are sent
the poll group receive returns messages 1 and 2
reading the connection directly returns message 3, held by the poll group receive
